fetch.step.check.detail: one request to its board or page — seconds
fetch.step.aggregators.detail: the boards that publish every posting they have, a polite second apart — well under a minute
fetch.step.all.detail: one request per board, a polite second apart — a few minutes
fetch.step.score.detail: filter, de-duplicate, then the AI scores each new job and alerts on matches — minutes for a big batch
fetch.step.store.detail: filter and de-duplicate; stored unscored — no AI spent while the pipeline is paused
fetch.youCanCloseThisPage: You can close this page — the run keeps going, and its row lands on Runs.
